integrity.computational_checks: Independent adjacency comparisons, direct feasibility tests, graph-structure checks and exhaustive small-case minima; reproduction code and recorded output attached.
integrity.independent_audit: Not performed; no independent certification claimed.
integrity.mathematical_proof: Complete finite-parameter symbolic proof using clique and link structure; finite verifier is supplementary.

scientific_limitations: The theorem treats classical Sierpiński graphs only, for \(n\ge1\), \(m\ge2\) and \(1\le k\le m-1\).
Minimum cardinality, not the number or classification of optimal sets, is established.
Other parameter regimes and generalized Sierpiński graph inputs are not covered.
Priority against unindexed or inaccessible literature is not definitively established.
title: Resolution of the \(k\)-limited domination conjecture for Sierpiński graphs
